**Note:** This is a 2 half-day workshop. Each half-day runs 13:00–17:00 with coffee breaks included.
:::

| 15:15–16:00 | [Module 3: ggplot2 Fundamentals](../slides/slide_block_3.qmd) | Layers, aesthetics, `geoms`, basic plots, grammar of graphics | [Slides](../slides/slide_block_3.qmd) | [Exercise](../exercises/exercise_block_3.qmd) |
| 16:00–16:15 | *Coffee Break* | | | |
| 16:15–17:00 | [Module 4: Styling & Themes](../slides/slide_block_4.qmd) | Scales, themes, annotations, legends, color palettes, visual hierarchy | [Slides](../slides/slide_block_4.qmd) | [Exercise](../exercises/exercise_block_4.qmd) |
